Market today: Tech is still the main driver, but the broader market's reaction to inflation and rates is key. Your concentrated tech/chip book, especially on margin, means any dip hits hard.

Your holdings: SOXL (-34.89%) and SPAL (-34.29%) are the big red flags needing attention. They're leveraged ETFs and decay is a killer, especially when they're down this much.

Watch: Micron (MUU) news and Meta's VR/AI push. Also, keep an eye on that mortgage rate jump.

Bottom line: Focus on managing your leveraged losers and watching for any signs of a broader tech sector shift.
plays: SOXL: Consider trimming to reduce margin risk, especially if it breaks below its current price.
SPAL: Similar to SOXL, evaluate trimming to manage downside exposure.
No new buys today - hold and watch
